pr_title: fix 'play from here' context menu item
pr_body:
## Description
in https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/pull/13992 the `videoplayer.autoplaynext` setting has been changed from a bool to a list of int's.

the code in GUIWindowVideoBase.cpp that toggles one of the context menu items from '_Play from here_' to '_Play only this_' based on that setting, was not updated to adopt this.

as a result it will currently always add '_Play from here_'  to the context menu.

## Motivation and Context
fixes https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/18347

## How Has This Been Tested?
tested in Estuary, using various combinations of the `videoplayer.autoplaynext` setting.
checked the context menu on a movie, episode, musicvideo and an unclassified video
and confirmed it correctly shows either '_Play from here_' or '_Play only this_' based on the value of `videoplayer.autoplaynext`

issue_context.title: Kodi v18.8 on Nvidia Shield missing Play Only, when autoplaynext is enabled
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug
when you have any combination of Auto Play Next for Video Items configured, it will only show "Play from here" as an option, and the "Play only this" is never shown.  As the code still has the "Play only this" context menu still in the code, but there was a change  to the videoplayer.autoplaynext option from a boolean to a string, it seems that this code was missed in xbmc/video/windows/GUIWindowVideoBase.cpp on line 892.

## Expected Behavior
When auto play is enabled, the context menu "Play from here", should change to "Play only this"


## Actual Behavior
No matter the the configuration only "Play from here" is in the context menu.


### To Reproduce
1. Turn on Autoplaynext for the video 
2. go to a movie and open up the context menu
